source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-23

procedures.title: Distributor (breaker point type): disassemble
steps: On the tester, check spark variation, centrifugal and vacuum advance, and point condition to see what needs replacing.
Look at the breaker plate under the points; a smudgy line means oil or crankcase vapor has been getting between the points.
V8 (see figure 13i in the manual): remove the rotor.
Remove both weight springs and advance weights.
Drive out the roll pin holding the driven gear and slide the gear and spacers off the shaft; on Corvette, also remove the tachometer drive gear.
Remove any burrs from the shaft before pulling it, so the seals and bushing in the housing are not damaged.
Slide the mainshaft and cam-weight base assembly out of the housing.
Remove the vacuum advance unit screws and the unit.
Remove the spring retainer and lift out the breaker plate assembly; take the points and condenser off the plate.
Remove the felt washer and plastic seal under the breaker plate.

procedures.title: Distributor (breaker point type): clean and inspect
steps: Wash everything in solvent except the cap, rotor, condenser, breaker plate assembly and vacuum unit (solvent harms insulation and soaks the breaker plate lube felt).
Check the breaker plate assembly for damage or wear; replace as needed.
Check the shaft for wear and its fit in the body bushings; replace worn shaft or bushings.
Support the shaft in V-blocks and measure runout with a dial gauge; it must not exceed .002".
